t: You're looking at a Penfold pillar box on St Martin's le Grand. It is painted green, which is unusual for a postbox. The colour marks five hundred years since Brian Tuke became the first Master of the Posts. Tuke was secretary to Henry VIII and to Cardinal Wolsey. He served as the first Governor of the King's Posts from 1517 until 1545. So this green box is a small tribute to the man who stands at the start of the royal post.
